lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 6 primary high-contrast vertical lines with 2 additional abbreviated/faint segments at the anterior and posterior margins. Spacing is relatively equidistant across the central torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Anterior-most line (closest to neck) and posterior-most line (closest to haunch) terminate prematurely before crossing the torso midline. Central lines 2 and 5 (counting from anterior) show thinning or partial pixel gaps in the lower third of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low density; one high-contrast primary spot on the upper posterior haunch and two smaller, lower-intensity spots located on the posterior distal thigh.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Dual-spiral lyrate curvature; horns originate at approximately a 40-degree lateral angle from the skull, curving posteriorly and then medially towards the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Approximately 2.1:1 ratio between the pixel distance of the horn tips compared to the pixel width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15 of the total horn length exhibits high-contrast ivory/bright-pixel tipping.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial chevron between the orbital regions; two distinct white spots on the right cheek (malar region); tricolor limb markers consisting of black lower distal segments, white bands, and orange/tan proximal segments.
